title: DHS Touts Deportation of Five Transnational Gang Members Tied to MS-13, Sinaloa Cartel, 18th Street, Latin Kings
detail: DHS published a press release on September 2, 2026 detailing the deportation of five men with gang affiliations — two MS-13 members from El Salvador and Honduras, one Sinaloa Cartel member from Mexico, one 18th Street gang member from Guatemala, and one Latin Kings member from Uruguay — removed in a series of flights between roughly August 24 and 29, 2026. DHS said the men had convictions or charges including abduction, assault, battery, methamphetamine trafficking, firearm possession, burglary, vehicle theft, human trafficking, and illegal re-entry. Secretary Markwayne Mullin said 'the brave men and women of ICE made our country safer by deporting illegal alien gang members.' The release is part of a recurring 'Make America Safe Again' series DHS has published roughly weekly through 2026 highlighting individual removal cases.

title: ICE Detainee Lianyong Wei Dies Hours After Intake in Saipan; China Demands Investigation
detail: Lianyong Wei, 51, a Chinese national whose legal status had lapsed in 2019, was arrested Aug 21, 2026 by Northern Mariana Islands police on assault allegations against a family of five, transferred to ICE custody Aug 22, and found unresponsive during a routine morning check at the Saipan detention facility on Aug 23; he was pronounced dead at a hospital. ICE announced the death and China's formal diplomatic protest became public on September 2, 2026. Cause of death is under investigation, and DHS declined to confirm whether the legally required 12-hour intake health screening occurred. Wei is the 57th immigrant detainee to die since Trump's second term began (24 in calendar 2026 alone) and at least the fifth Chinese national to die in ICE/CBP custody since March 2025. China's government formally pressed the U.S. for a 'timely and thorough investigation,' notification of findings, and preventive measures.

title: DHS: ICE August 2026 Arrests Hit Record 50,925, Third Straight Monthly High
detail: DHS announced on September 2, 2026 that ICE arrested 50,925 people in August 2026, surpassing a revised July total of 50,208 and marking the third consecutive month of record monthly arrests and the second straight month over 50,000. Secretary Markwayne Mullin said 'for the third straight month, ICE set a new record for the highest number of illegal aliens arrested in a single month, nearly 51,000,' and DHS said more than 300,000 arrests have been logged in 2026 to date. The revised July figure of 50,208 in this release does not match the 49,571 July total reported by AP/PBS NewsHour on Aug 25, 2026, a discrepancy that has not been reconciled by DHS.
